page.overview:
Who is Roman Counterparts?

When the Romans took over Greece, they adapted their religion. The Greek gods' names were changed and they became more warlike. Here is a list of them. {| class="collapsible collapsed" width="30%" style="border:5px solid #000;"

Those are the main deities of Greek mythology turned to Roman. You may have recognised that some of the roman gods have planets named after them, e.g. Neptune.
